The person behind the work

Hi, I’m Hope.
A builder, first.

My full name is Anzolo Kpazhi Hope. You may also know me as Hope Anzolo or Anzolo Hope. I’m a software engineer, AI & Digital Systems Architect, educator and the founder of ECHUKU.

I work from Lagos, Nigeria, with a focus on the everyday realities of African businesses. I care about what happens after a demonstration: when the team starts using the tool, a connection drops, a customer asks an unexpected question or a manager needs to understand a decision.

I began my software journey in 2014. Over time, my work has brought together websites, business applications, automation, AI products and education. Earlier coverage describes that journey through GlemVNT and Falzz; today ECHUKU is central to how I describe my work, with DZEVA as my evolving AI platform direction.

A milestone I treasure

In 2025, I received the Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Year Award at the Africa Future Leadership Conference & Awards 10.0. I am grateful for the recognition and the responsibility it brings.

Read my award reflection and see the photographs →

What I believe

Technology should reduce the weight of doing useful work. It should help you see your process more clearly, make better decisions and serve people with greater care. It should not require you to pretend that your power supply, internet connection or team’s working day is something it is not.

AI brings intelligence. Problem-solving skills and judgement define human value.

I want my writing to feel like a conversation you can act on. Sometimes that means explaining an engineering decision. Sometimes it means helping you ask a better question before buying anything.

Learning and sharing

I share practical guidance on AI adoption, business systems, careers and the future of human work. My educational work includes the AI Career Guide and the Anzolo Hope AI Fellowship Membership community. You can start with the free guide and reach out about joining the free community.

My public speaker profile also lists Speak Tech and the 216 AI Career Guide. Explore my speaker profile for the subjects I discuss.

Let’s begin with your problem

You may be building a business, choosing a career direction or looking for a speaker who can make AI understandable. Tell me what you are trying to do. That is a useful place for us to start.
